Why Sanskriti?

Skills that need new hands

Many traditional skills in India are learned from parents and grandparents. Today fewer young people get the chance to see them, let alone try them. Artisans' families face low and unsteady incomes and competition from machine-made goods.

Big websites already show beautiful pictures of Indian crafts. Sanskriti goes one step further: it helps you find a real place to experience a skill for yourself.
